comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus system.reboot decisions for luci-mod-system-reboot from pinned uhttpd uh_ubus_allowed, reboot.js rpc.declare, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=system function=reboot (uhttpd omits scope).
Bounded to reboot.js rpc.declare object=system method=reboot at luci b2e0be4b. That is procd system, not rpcd rpc-sys.
Fixture login luci-mod-system-reboot is write of the existing ACL group. Do not invent a write flash login.
file.exec of /sbin/reboot on the same ACL is unused by reboot.js. flash.js /sbin/reboot stays unstaffed.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or reboot().
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers.
luci-mod-system flash.js write sysupgrade/firstboot stay unstaffed.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping is not this slice.
crontab.js cron reload is not this slice (ubus file.write, not file.exec).

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus system.reboot
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access system/reboot false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated system.reboot grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-reboot is not a stock device login. reboot.js uses rpc.declare object=system method=reboot. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC. Does not invent a write flash login.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-reboot list write luci-mod-system-reboot

cases.note: The list-read flash fixture has ubus file.exec, not system.reboot. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. Do not invent a write flash login.
rpcd sys.c registers object rpc-sys. reboot.js calls system.reboot. No luci-ssl grant for rpc-sys.reboot.
Stock root list read/write '*' is intended_access (root-administration), not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package overlay rpcd.config root read/write '*'
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: explicit data:null is not a table and returns ERROR_PARSE
omitted data defaults to an empty table in the policy wrapper; explicit JSON null remains null
